candidate_commit_message: CHG-170-r1: add broad qualified-yield search profile

migration.name: CHG-170 versioned live-search provenance and fail-closed eligibility
facts: Additive/idempotent columns store strategy profile, version, family, query kind/pass and initial order on search tasks, task results and source occurrences.
Jobs store annual base-pay minimum, hard-gate evidence, preference signals and preference adjustment.
Task-result provenance backfills from durable search tasks; previously handled actionables become ALREADY_HANDLED; legacy actionables without gate evidence become REVIEW.
Migration validation used temporary SQLite fixtures; production data/jobs.sqlite3 was not opened or changed.

tests.command: rtk env PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.unit.test_strategy tests.unit.test_qualification_gates tests.regression.test_scoring tests.integration.test_database_ledger tests.integration.test_browser_tasks -v
rtk env PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests
rtk env PYTHONPATH=src JOBBOT_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/jobbot-chg170-plan-cli python -m jobbot search-plan --mode staged
tests.result: PASS — 140 deterministic tasks; generated JSON/CSV/HTML in temporary output and matched the committed task/count payload exactly

after.deep_recall: All 7 enabled families have deep-phase coverage on LinkedIn, Indeed and Glassdoor.

sample_exact_queries.linkedin: provider lifecycle, credentialing, enrollment and provider data maintenance roles at health plans

search_plan_evidence.interpretation: Totals describe plan size, not result quality. Evidence demonstrates explicit correct-family/pass coverage and a guaranteed deep recall pass; it makes no yield claim from raw task counts.

hard_gate_matrix.positive_fixture: A posting with affirmative evidence for all gates can qualify as actionable.
hard_gate_matrix.failures_and_unknowns: Every tested failure or unknown remains non-actionable for home-only remote/Texas eligibility, full-time, permanent employee status, employer-provided base-pay floor, required travel/in-person conditions, current/open status, unsupported mandatory credential/skills/experience, and handled status.
hard_gate_matrix.preference_only: Admissions-sales/call-queue mismatch lowers preference ranking while retaining discovery and recall evidence.
hard_gate_matrix.ambiguity: Ambiguous title words do not establish fit; substantive responsibility evidence is required, otherwise existing review semantics apply.
hard_gate_matrix.no_repeat: After APPLIED, recommendation remains ALREADY_HANDLED; the application event and source sighting remain stored, duplicate sightings increment history, and daily actionable plan omits the handled job.

live_site_production_validation: NOT_RUN — separately human-gated runtime state; no LinkedIn, Indeed or Glassdoor production browsing was attempted.
production_ledger_validation: NOT_USED — no read, write or mutation of production data/jobs.sqlite3.
request_binding: This evidence is bound to the approved Project OS BUILD request CHG-170-r1 on codex/jobbot-CHG-170-r1.
evidence_commit_note: This evidence file is committed separately after the tested candidate code commit because a commit cannot contain its own final commit SHA.
